# Results (generated by `python -m research.run_all`)

## Data preparation (D1/D2)

- D1 raw: 4920 rows, 132 symptom columns, 41 diseases
- Removed column(s): fluid_overload (all-zero duplicate of an informative column)
- Duplicate rows removed: 4616 -> **304 unique patterns, 131 features**
- Missing values: 0
- Testing.csv: 41 of 41 rows already in Training.csv -> not used
- D2: 304 unique patterns, 304 match D1 -> consistency check only
- Split: 243 train / 61 test (stratified 80:20, after de-duplication)

Selection: best CV macro-F1; ties (within 0.01) broken by lowest CV log-loss. Tied: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, SVM, MLP. **Selected: MLP**. Deployed: MLP.

Kernel SHAP (background 15): top symptoms by mean |SHAP| - itching (0.0219), loss_of_appetite (0.0215), dark_urine (0.0212), joint_pain (0.0199), yellowing_of_eyes (0.0195), muscle_pain (0.0189), abdominal_pain (0.0186), mild_fever (0.0182)

> D1 has only ~300 unique symptom patterns (4,616 duplicates). Perfect held-out scores reflect a small, highly separable dataset, not real-world diagnostic accuracy.
